# Get Up and Flow

> Get Up and Flow provides daily ADHD / executive-function accountability coaching for adults: the same dedicated human coach on call 8am-5pm, Monday-Friday. Full Support is $750/month (about 195 covered hours; under $4 per covered hour). Focus Lite is $200/month (weekly 20-minute planning call plus daily text reminders). Traditional ADHD coaches charge $75-$250/hour for one session a week. Coaching is remote, cancel anytime, coach assigned within 48 hours. Not therapy; not covered by insurance.

## Key facts

- Same coach every day; service hours 8am-5pm ET, Monday-Friday
- Full Support $750/month: morning Jump Start planning session, reminders through the day, up to 45 min/day of Bonus Time help, optional end-of-day Retro
- Focus Lite $200/month: weekly 20-minute planning call, daily WhatsApp/text reminders
- Founded by Brian Fischman and Bruce Parsons, MD, PhD (psychiatrist/neuroscientist; Columbia; former Global Head of Pain & Psychiatry, Pfizer)
- Contact: hello@getupandflow.co
